verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs show that audiences are built and then connected to audience outputs (partner integrations chosen from the Directory) for activation. Related materials cover audience engagement, composable audiences, and activation for ad reach and match rates. However, nothing in the pack shows that sync is continuous or that members enter and exit audiences in near-real-time, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time or continuous audience membership updates (entry and exit) pushed to downstream tools, documented sync latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of audience activation.
